The decision that shapes this trip

Build the Ruhudji visit around Samaki Camp’s own equipment guidance. Ask how rods and working tackle are stored in the fishing boat and which spare connections are useful. Keep the main tigerfish outfit accessible during transfers instead of packing it beneath unrelated safari luggage.

Keep transfers and tackle connected

Confirm the camp or boat transfer, the target for each day and the working lure or fly selection. Ask about spare components before carrying duplicate outfits. Keep tropical river access guided unless a specific independent arrangement has been established.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Tanzania

Mainland law exempts rod-and-line or handline fishing from a beach without a fishing vessel. This exemption excludes declared trout streams and spawning grounds. Boat trips, conserved areas and Zanzibar need separate checks.

Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Release all fish and use single hooks with the barbs removed.
  • Follow the beat rotation; do not fish a beat twice in one week.
  • Do not re-drift a beat or enter fish spawning areas.

Full Tanzania licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
